name: project-workbook-method
description: Claude Code mods of the Project Workbook standard: the workbook loaded at session start, and the update triggers applied at the end of a turn.

plugins.name: workbook-loader
plugins.description: Loads the project workbook's start.md, status.md and newest journal entries into the session before its first turn, in full.

plugins.name: workbook-triggers
plugins.description: At the end of a turn with signs of recordable work, asks a fork of the session whether an update trigger fired, and has the agent write the entry.
